LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Carb. ac.]
Aching in both hips ; in right hip and left knee.
Rheumatic pain in right hip joint.
Deep-seated muscular pain on inside of upper third of l. thigh.
A faint feeling spreading from thighs all over body.
Aching soreness beneath left patella, all day up to about 4 o'clock P. M. ; feels as if it would be stiff and sore to move it, but is not felt at all.
Sore, bruised feeling, or tingling-itching in leg, during motion.
Lower extremities feel heavy as lead.
Paralysis of lower extremities ; t. θ Meningitis.
Sensation just below knee on skin as if it was touched with a piece of ice.
Sharp pain in left shin.
Aching pain to left of middle of left shin bone.
Dull pain in right ankle and left knee.
Bruised pain beneath left tendo-achillis.
Pain in great toes.
Feet feel heavy, bruised.
Fetid perspiration of feet.
Carbuncle on hip of lady, æt. 50.
Œdema of both legs ; t. θ Meningitis.
Chronic ulcers on feet and ankles.
Chronic ulcers on feet and ankles, deep, emitting a strong odor and burning like fire.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Carb. ac.]
Numb ache in arms and legs. θ Remittent fever.
Stiffness of limbs. θ Hydrocephaloid.
Cold hands and feet.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Carb. ac.]
Lying : in bed, tired.
Sitting : down < vertigo ; crampy stitch left inguinal region.
Bending : head forward < headache.
Stooping : coldness in head.
Writing : letters run together.
Walking : fast > vertigo ; rumbling in bowels ; pain in l. ovary ; up-stairs, short breath ; out-doors, feeling of expansion in lungs and nasal passages ; heart beats.
   

NERVES. [36] [Carb. ac.]
(In sick :) She had nervous trembling.
Trembling, uncertain, straggling walk.
Tonic spasms of arms.
Trembling and convulsions.
Partial convulsive movements. θ Hydrocephaloid.
Easily fatigued by least walk.
Complains of feeling very tired, even while lying in bed. θ Remittent fever.
Feels as if he had taken a bad cold. θ Remittent fever.
General malaise, great languor and weakness.
Profound prostration ; physical exhaustion ; surface pale, bathed in cold sweat ; collapse.
Became thoroughly unfit for study, as every exercise at reading increased all symptoms, especially pressing at occiput.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Carb. ac.]
Yawning, with desire to take long inspirations.
Constant inclination to yawn, languid and sleepy, desire to stretch.
(In sick :) She slept by spells ; sleep unsatisfactory ; fitful starting.
Sleeps uneasily, starts ; eyes half closed. θ Scarlatina.
Wakes often during night.
Heavy and sleepy, perplexed with dreams, wakes unrefreshed.
Somnolency, sopor, ending in coma.
Dreams : unable to recall ; of fire ; amorous ; of traveling.
   

TIME. [38] [Carb. ac.]
Night : dyspepsia < ; fearful beating of heart ; severe pain in lumbo-sacral region ; wakes often ; sweat.
Morning : headache in upper half of head ; nausea.
All day up to 4 o'clock ; aching pain beneath patella.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Carb. ac.]
Room feels close and hot.
Cold : hand, pressure > aching and burning pain in forehead ; water, nausea.
Open air : chilly ; watery discharge from both nostrils ; walking in, pain in region of left ovary.
   

FEVER. [40] [Carb. ac.]
Chilly sensation while in a warm room.
Chill in open air.
A momentary chill runs from face downward, in a hot room.
Chill, followed by fever and very slight sweat, with numb ache in arms and legs ; pulse small and rapid ; < about sundown and through night ; felt as if he had taken a bad cold.
High fever, alternating with often recurring chills of short duration, followed by profuse sweat, with restlessness. θ Puerperal fever.
Was covered with perspiration.
Sweat at night.
Typhoid and low miasmatic fevers.
Fever of enteric type.
Remittent fever, occurring every autumn.
Intermittent fever, with enlargement of spleen.
Scarlet fever.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Carb. ac.]
Pains sharp, come suddenly, last a short time, disappear suddenly.
Periodical : spells of sick headache.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Carb. ac.]
Symptoms go from head downward.
Affected right side first and afterwards same parts of left. θ Remittent fever.
From left to right : frontal headache.
Left : bruised pain beneath tendo-achillis ; aching pain in knee ; pain in thigh ; sharp pain in shin ; dull pain in knee ; frontal headache from left to right ; pressure in temple ; small pustules on vertex ; constant dark spots in front of eye ; eye, watering ; pressing pain in ear ; nostril, stinging ; wing of nose, sensation of fine electric sparks ; swelling and soreness of inner side of cheek ; pain in region of ovary ; larynx very sore to pressure ; dull aching in chest ; oppression of chest and frontal headache, going from left to right ; transient pain under clavicle ; slight tingling along side of chest ; jerking, common carotid ; pain in shoulder like a toothache ; arm, drawing pain ; tingling burning in arm ; aching in forearm, also creeping shuddering ; constant tired heavy feeling in arm.
Right : burning pain in temple ; very severe neuralgia over eye and patella ; ear, itching ; in jaw, drawing pain ; itching of cheek ; pustular eruption ; aching of teeth, upper jaw ; sore throat ; chest, pain ; pain in hypochondrium ; inguinal region, crampy stitch ; iliac fossa, tenderness ; senses as of fine electric sparks on sternal end of clavicle ; twitching in sterno-cleido-mastoid muscle ; stitching pain in neck ; rheumatic pain in shoulder ; soreness of muscles ; twitching of arm ; contractive pain in palms of hand ; tingling itching, little finger ; pain in second phalangeal joint of middle finger ; aching in hip and knee ; dull pain in ankle.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Carb. ac.]
As if an india-rubber band was stretched tightly over forehead, from temple to temple ; as of fine electric sparks in vertex ; as if brain was swashing about ; as of fine electric sparks left wing of nose ; as if a thousand pins were pricking tongue ; as if a load was pressing in front of chest ; as if diaphragm depressed lungs ; as if compressed, chest ; of fine electric sparks on sternal end of right clavicle ; as though it would be impossible to raise arm ; as of fine electric sparks on middle finger of left hand ; as if just below knee or shin had been touched with a piece of ice ; as if he had taken a bad cold.
Pain : over right eyebrow ; under right patella ; from throat into ear ; in right hypochondrium ; in region of left ovary ; in right lung ; severe in lumbo-sacral region ; in right shoulder ; in second phalangeal joint of middle finger of right hand ; in left thigh ; in great toe.
Acute piercing pain : on left supraorbital ridge.
Sharp : pain in head ; pain centre of cheek ; in right hypochonder ; in left shin.
Darting : pain in head.
Jagging pains : in head.
Stitches : region of heart ; crampy, in left inguinal region ; in right side of neck.
Boring pains ; in small of back.
Prickling : in vertex ; through glans, penis, and urethra.
Twitching : pains through temples ; right sterno-cleido muscle.
Beating pain : in both ears.
Jerking : in left common carotid artery.
Burning : pain in top of head ; in brain ; of lips ; of tongue ; in throat ; in abdomen ; in rectum ; down left arm ; ulcer on lower extremities ; in forehead ; in right temple and vertex ; in stomach.
Biting : on tongue.
Stinging : in left nostril.
Pressing : pain through temples, in top of head ; pain left ear ; in hypochondrium.
Pressure : in left temple ; in occiput ; in muscles of back of neck ; under sternum.
Drawing : pain left arm ; pain in jaw ; in muscles of neck.
Neuralgia : of eyes ; of temples.
Dragging : across loins.
Bruised : feeling in leg ; pain beneath left tendo-achillis.
Rheumatic : pains in right shoulder ; in right hip joint.
Distension : in abdomen.
Expansive : pains in head.
Sore : abdomen ; feeling in legs ; inside of cheeks ; in stomach and bowels ; of respiratory organs ; muscles of back and limbs.
Aching : small of back ; pain in shoulders ; left forearm ; in forehead ; in stomach ; of teeth ; of left side of chest ; in both hips and knee ; in left middle of shin bone ; beneath l. patella ; in leg.
Dull pain : running from forehead to occiput ; under left clavicle ; in right ankle.
Throbbing : entire head.
Contracting pain : in palms.
Digging feeling : low down in abdomen.
Colic-like pains : in abdomen.
Crampy stitch : in left inguinal region.
Uncomfortable feeling : across stomach and liver.
Narrowness : of chest.
Tight feeling : in both lungs ; across forehead ; in nose between eyes.
Stiff : neck ; feeling in hand.
Tired : in renal region ; of left arm.
Lame : neck.
Sinking feeling : all over abdomen.
Faint feeling : spreading from thighs all over body.
Horripilation : left forearm.
Numbness : of skin of hands ; in head ; in ear.
Tingling : of tongue ; in throat ; down left arm ; in ear ; l. side of chest.
Tickling : of throat.
Full : feeling in throat ; in head ; in stomach.
Heavy : as lead, lower extremities ; feeling in head ; of left arm.
Weight : on neck ; in epigastrium ; in stomach.
Shuddering : left forearm.
Creeping : left forearm.
Coldness : when nerve of tooth is touched.
Chilly : while in a warm room.
Hot : abdomen ; in rectum.
Itching : lower abdomen ; of scalp ; of right ear ; of nose ; of face ; of anus ; of genitals ; of scrotum and inside of thighs ; of back of neck and back ; in little fingers ; tingling in leg ; of skin.
Dryness : in throat ; of mouth and lips.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Carb. ac.]
Putrid discharges from mouth, throat, nostrils, ears, rectum and vagina.
Œdema of feet, hands and face, with soapy, colorless complexion ; after loss of blood.
Scarlatina maligna.
Confluent variola ; no secondary fever.
Carious bones ; necrosis ; osteosarcoma ; sinuses.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Carb. ac.]
Touch : tooth, coldness ; l. supraorbital spot sore to.
Reading : numbness of head ; pressure in occiput.
Extensive scald (in glycerine externally).
Burns, especially if they ulcerate and discharge is offensive.
Lacerated wounds from blunt instruments ; bones bare or crushed and splintered.
   

SKIN. [46] [Carb. ac.]
Offensive odor from skin.
Erysipelas.
Itching of skin of various parts of body ; > by scratching, but soon returns.
Innumerable small (miliary) vesicles over whole body.
Eruption not diffused equitably over entire surface, interrupted in many places, and of a dusky red color. θ Scarlatina.
Malignant forms of scarlatina.
Pustular and vesicular eruptions.
Confluent variola.
Acne, eczema, impetigo, scabies, psoriasis inveterata, leprosy ; prurigo ; pityriasis versicolor ; lupus, carbuncles and cancerous sores ; sloughing wounds ; chronic ulcers.
Ulcers with foul odor.
Extensive burns or scalds.
Chilblains and chapped hands.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Carb. ac.]
Two children, 9 months old. θ Summer complaint.
B., æt. 10 ; psoriasis.
Lady ; æt. 18 ; variola.
Miss, æt. 19 ; hysterical vomiting.
Young lady, æt 21 ; variola.
Woman, æt 39 ; dyspepsia.
Woman, æt. 46, scrofulous diathesis ; chronic ulcers on feet and ankles.
Woman, æt. 50 ; carbuncle on hip.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Carb. ac.]
Antidotes : chalk, but better Calc. sacch., prepared by dissolving sixteen parts refined sugar in forty parts water, and adding five parts slaked lime ; digest three days ; stir occasionally, filter, and evaporate to dryness.
Huseman and Wood say, use sweet oil or castor oil as an antidote, as according to Lemaire it will cause the acid to be more slowly absorbed ; emetics are generally useless.
Incompatible : glycerine and vegetable oils being solvents spread and increase its action.
Compare : Gelsem., Mercur. and Sulphur in bandlike headache ; Arsenic., Carb. veg., Cinchon. and Kreosot. in burns, ulcers, etc., with unhealthy, offensive discharge.
